This <s>rasendra</s> (king mercury), in a dose the size of a louse-egg, when taken together with sugar,
makes a man beautiful in every limb by a single use.
It gives great sovereignty equal to <s>Rudra</s>'s and prowess equal to <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s.
It gives fine radiance equal to the moon and burning splendor equal to the sun,
a lifespan equal to that of the four-faced <s>Brahmā</s>, and eyes like the sight of <s>Tārkṣya</s>.
When it has been properly colored, made to flow, and furnished with <s>krāmaṇa</s> (penetrative operation),
this becomes <s>śabdavedhin</s> (piercing by sound), facing every direction like <s>Śiva</s>.
By texts beginning with the <s>Manthānabhairava</s>, extending over hundreds of crores,
and even by crores of the great qualities of this <s>rasa</s> in their entirety,

children.text: śakyaṃ tenaiva saṃstotuṃ taraṅgā iva sāgare ||
children.translated_text: it can be praised only by itself, like the waves in the ocean.
Because of the practitioner's small capacity and because <s>Śaṅkara</s> has not shown favor,
because medicines are not known properly and remedies have been obtained improperly,
because substances such as sulphur are not understood and because the practice is not done correctly,

children.text: na sidhyati kalau sūtaḥ saṃśayena prakurvatām ||
children.translated_text: <s>sūta</s> (mercury) does not succeed in the Kali age for those who act with doubt.
If it is unable to undergo upward and downward distillation, its path being obstructed and its luster poor,
mercury that has digested mica is then called 'one whose wings have been cut.'
When it has digested an equal amount of mica it is a child; with twice the mica it is an adolescent.
It is a youth when it has consumed fourfold mica, and when it has digested sixfold mica,
it becomes old and also very old when the mica is eightfold.
The child is to be prepared by the appropriate process as an agent for the body and metals.
The boy, when it has reached the state of a paste, becomes able to act on the body and metals.
Mercury made to flow with gold is a youth and brings about success.
When old, after it has reached the state of ash, it acts on the body and metals.
The extremely old <s>rasa</s>, the aged one, placed in the mouth, bestows all siddhis.

children.text: tatra bālaḥ kumāraśca neṣyate tu rasāyane
children.translated_text: Among these, the child and the boy are not desired for <s>rasāyana</s> (rejuvenation).
The young one is for the destruction of diseases and also protects the body.
The old and the extremely old both act on the body and metals.
When digested with an equal amount of mica, it becomes somewhat like a thousand fires.
When it has digested twice the mica, it does not at all pass into smoke.
With threefold mica, the lordly mercury attains a binding like curd.
Mercury brings about bodily perfection when fourfold <s>vyoman</s> (mica) has been digested.
<s>Rasa</s> that has digested sixfold mica grants the lifespan of <s>Brahmā</s>.
When it has digested sevenfold mica, it gives long life together with strength.
When eightfold mica has been digested, it bestows the lifespan of <s>Śaṅkara</s>.
Mercury whose morsel has not been digested should be subjected to <s>pātana</s> (distillation), then rekindled and digested again.

children.text: tataḥ śulbasya tīkṣṇasya kāntasya rajatasya ca
children.translated_text: Thereafter one should prepare the seeds of copper, <s>tīkṣṇa</s> (sharp iron), <s>kānta</s> (magnetic iron), and silver,
and also of gold, and should digest them completely.
The melting and digestion are according to the procedure stated for mica.
The coloring of mercury is said to be the digestion of <s>tīkṣṇa</s>, <s>kānta</s>, and <s>arka</s>.
One should carry out the required operations carefully with the appropriate alkaline and sour steamings.

children.text: śatadhā daradavyūḍhaṃ tāmraṃ hi triguṇaṃ rase ||
children.translated_text: Copper, drawn out a hundred times with <s>darada</s>, is indeed used in mercury in threefold amount.
Through digestion with that, it becomes like molten ruby.
With copper, mercury is powerful, with prowess equal to the sun.
This <s>rasa</s> fully revives one who has been exhausted by the three doṣas.
When this <s>rasa</s>, weighed daily by a <s>guñjā</s>, is taken for a month,

children.text: kuryādbhīmasamaṃ martyaṃ mukte ca bhuji vikramam ||
children.translated_text: it makes a mortal equal to <s>Bhīma</s>, with heroic strength in his freed arm.
<s>Krāmaṇa</s>, <s>jāraṇa</s>, <s>vedha</s>, <s>rañjana</s>, and rapid activity
arise in mercury from a morsel of <s>tīkṣṇa</s> after it has been drawn out by a hundred portions of <s>hiṅgula</s>.
Mercury digested with equal parts of <s>tīkṣṇa</s>, when taken in a quarter-measure for two months,

children.text: karoti martyaṃ gatamṛtyubhītiṃ mahābalaṃ dhvastarujaṃ suputram ||
children.translated_text: makes a mortal free from fear of death, very strong, rid of disease, and blessed with good sons.
Mercury digested with two, three, four, and fivefold <s>tīkṣṇa</s>,
has qualities higher and higher; who in this world could describe them?
Likewise, <s>rasa</s> digested with <s>kānta</s> becomes a crore times greater in qualities.

children.text: dviguṇajaritakānto vyādhibādhāṃ hinasti harati ca rasa uccairvyādhivakraṃ kṣaṇena
children.translated_text: <s>Rasa</s> with twice-digested <s>kānta</s> destroys the affliction of disease and instantly removes disease's attack at its height.

children.text: valipalitavikāraṃ duḥkhadāridryamṛtyuṃ janayati varaputraṃ saccaritraṃ rasendraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rasendra</s> removes wrinkles, gray hair, deformity, sorrow, poverty, and death, and produces an excellent son of good character.
By a quarter part, by a half part, by three quarters, by an equal part,
by double and triple parts, and likewise by a fivefold part,
the great <s>rasa</s>, digested with gold from <s>mākṣīka</s> drawn out a hundred times,
becomes worshiped in the three worlds and arises like a wish-fulfilling jewel.
With cow's liquid used for washing, into which alkali from the five-part root has been thrown,
sulphur-stone, impregnated a hundred times, becomes a <s>biḍa</s> (alkaline flux) for digesting gold and the rest.
Gold digested in equal measure, worthy beyond all powers, when taken for only a solar day in a dose of one <s>māṣa</s>,

children.text: bahuvidhagadamuktaṃ hanti vārdhakyamuccaiḥ vṛkajaṭharadṛḍhāśauddāmam agniṃ ca kuryāt ||
children.translated_text: frees one from many kinds of disease, powerfully destroys old age, and makes the digestive fire unrestrained and strong like a wolf's belly.
It destroys infertility, disease, and incurability in a man from every side;
there is no doubt, and it makes the man possess a hundredfold wealth.
